title: The graph map x -> y + q(graphPoint x (v x)) is C^1 with derivative h -> q(graphPoint h (Dv(x) h))
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, q a linear isometric equivalence of R^{n+l}, v : R^n -> R^l, y in R^{n+l} and U an open subset of R^n. If v is C^1 on U, then Psi(x) := y + q(graphPoint x (v x)) is C^1 on U, and for every x in U and h in R^n, fderiv Psi x h = q(graphPoint h (fderiv v x h)).
lean_statement: ∀ {n ℓ : ℕ} (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (v : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (y : Amb n ℓ) (U : Set (Rn n)), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 v U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => y + q (graphPoint x (v x))) U ∧ ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ h : Rn n, fderiv ℝ (fun x => y + q (graphPoint x (v x))) x h = q (graphPoint h (fderiv ℝ v x h))
